preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains at most 13 characters, including the ellipsis if necessary.

postconditions.expression: all(line.split() == [str(len(s[i:])), s[i:].replace('...', '')[:5] + '...' + s[i:].replace('...', '')[-2:]] for i, line in enumerate(output))
postconditions.description: For each suffix s[i:], the output line contains the length of the suffix and the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained by applying the algorithm to that suffix, with ellipsis if necessary.
